channel.title: Frontion News Headlines
channel.description: Curated geopolitical headlines from Tier 1 and Tier 2 sources

item.title: 🇷🇺🇺🇦 Russia cancels annual Navy Day parade in St. Petersburg as Ukrainian deep-strike capabilities threaten major cities
item.description: Russia has canceled its annual Navy Day parade in St. Petersburg for the second year in a row, as Ukraine increasing deep-strike capabilities put even heavily defended Russian cities at risk.

item.title: 🇰🇵🇷🇺 Russia seeking 30,000 more troops from North Korea, Zelenskyy says
item.description: Moscow and Pyongyang signed a mutual assistance pact in 2024, and Zelenskyy says Russia now wants 30,000 additional North Korean troops for the war in Ukraine.

item.title: 🇨🇳🇵🇱 China blacklists Polish university on European dual-use export controls list
item.description: China has added a Polish university to its dual-use exports blacklist, signaling escalating tech tensions between Beijing and European institutions over sensitive technology transfers.

item.title: 🇺🇦🚢 Civilian cargo ship carrying grain sinks in Black Sea near Odesa after Russian missile strike
item.description: A civilian cargo ship sank on July 26 in the Black Sea near Odesa after being struck by Russian missiles on July 19 while transporting grain, marking another attack on civilian shipping.

item.title: ⚔️🇺🇸🇬🇧 US Air Force EA-37B electronic warfare aircraft arrive at RAF Fairford as Iran threatens UK base
item.description: EA-37B Compass Call aircraft have deployed to RAF Fairford in the UK, a key hub for USAF bomber missions against Iran, as Tehran threatens to attack the British air base.

item.title: 🇺🇸⚔️ Pentagon quietly removes 4 US troop deaths from Iran war casualty count
item.description: The Defense Department removed four American soldiers killed during renewed Iran fighting from its official war toll, reclassifying them under a new "Overseas Operations" category. The move raises questions about transparency as the Trump administration faces growing scrutiny over the conflict's human cost.

item.title: 🇮🇳✊ India Cockroach Janta protests force education minister resignation in blow to Modi
item.description: A Gen Z movement dubbed the Cockroach Janta Party forced the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan after leaked exam papers sparked mass protests and student suicides. The unprecedented uprising poses the biggest challenge to Modi's grip on power since he took office in 2014.

item.title: 🇧🇷🏛️ Brazil denies visas to US officials amid election interference concerns
item.description: Brazil's Foreign Ministry denied visas to two US State Department officials who sought to travel to Brasilia, calling their visit an attempt to cast doubt on October's presidential elections. The move escalates diplomatic tensions between the Lula and Trump administrations over tariffs and election integrity.

item.title: 🇺🇦🕊️ Ukraine and US discuss air ceasefire proposal ahead of Trump-Zelensky meeting
item.description: Ukrainian and US officials have discussed proposing an air ceasefire to Russia, Reuters reports, ahead of Volodymyr Zelenskyy's visit to Washington on Tuesday. The Kremlin called it premature to comment. Romania shot down a third Russian drone in three days, and a cargo ship sank off Odesa after a Russian attack killed 9 crew.

item.title: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 US pauses Iran strikes for second night as military advises against escalation
item.description: The US paused airstrikes on Iran for a second consecutive night after top military officials warned Trump about dwindling munitions stockpiles and the limits of the bombing campaign. Iran also halted retaliatory operations. Diplomatic negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz continue amid a two-week surge in violence that killed 4 US soldiers.

item.title: 🇮🇷⚔️ Iran says Ukrainian attack on vessel in Caspian Sea killed a sailor
item.description: Iran confirmed that a Ukrainian naval drone strike on a vessel in the Caspian Sea killed one sailor, marking an escalation of the Ukraine-Russia conflict into the Caspian region and raising concerns about the war expanding beyond the Black Sea.

item.title: 🇩🇪🏳️‍🌈 Berlin Pride attack was Islamist terror, says German interior minister; suspect shot dead
item.description: Germany declared the deadly ramming attack near Berlin Pride an Islamist terror act. The suspect, a German-Lebanese citizen and IS supporter, was shot dead by police after a 24-hour manhunt. One woman was killed and 29 injured.

item.title: 🇫🇷🔥 Bordeaux under threat as France and Spain battle unprecedented wildfires
item.description: Wildfires advanced to within 15 km of Bordeaux as France and Spain battled blazes that forced over 300,000 people to evacuate. France called the situation unprecedented; Avila suffered Spain worst wildfire in recent history with over 50,000 hectares burned.

item.title: 🇰🇿🛢️ Kazakhstan Calls for Freezing Russia-Ukraine War as Drone Attacks Halt Oil Exports
item.description: President Tokayev urged freezing the Russia-Ukraine conflict beside Putin in Omsk, while Kazakhstan slashed oil production after Ukrainian drone attacks forced its main Black Sea export terminal to shut down.

item.title: 🇱🇧⚔️ Lebanon Accuses Israel of Obstructing Troop Deployment in Southern Pilot Zones
item.description: The Lebanese army says Israel is violating withdrawal agreements by continuing shellings and bulldozing operations, preventing Lebanese forces from taking over pilot zone villages in the south.

item.title: 🇮🇱🏛️ Netanyahu Vows to Visit New York Despite ICC Warrant, Accuses Mayor Mamdani of Fomenting Hate
item.description: The Israeli PM said he will speak at the UN General Assembly this fall, calling ICC war crimes charges bogus and accusing NYC Mayor Mamdani of turning groups against each other. Mamdani had previously threatened to arrest Netanyahu.

item.title: 🇬🇧🇺🇦 New UK PM Burnham Pledges Unwavering Ukraine Support Ahead of Zelensky Visit
item.description: Andy Burnham announced sharing of the UK's Stone Cloak electronic warfare IP with Ukraine as President Zelensky becomes the new prime minister's first international visitor at a naval base meeting.

item.title: 🇵🇸🔥 Israeli Settlers Set Fire to Mosques and Farmland in West Bank Amid Escalating Violence
item.description: Settlers attacked two villages overnight, burning mosques under construction and vandalizing property, following a deadly clash in Tal village that killed four Palestinians and two Israelis.

item.title: 🇷🇴 Romania shoots down third Russian drone in three days, summons ambassador
item.description: Romania shot down a third drone in as many days over the Black Sea and summoned Russia's ambassador over repeated airspace violations. The incidents raise fears of the Ukraine war spilling over into NATO territory, with Romania's president identifying at least one drone as a Russian Shahed model.

item.title: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 US pauses Iran attacks for second night as military advised Trump to halt bombing
item.description: The US has paused strikes on Iran for a second consecutive night after top military officials warned Trump that the campaign had reached the limits of its effectiveness and munitions stockpiles were dwindling. Iran also halted retaliatory attacks. Diplomatic talks over the Strait of Hormuz continue amid fears of energy supply disruption.

item.title: 🇮🇱🇸🇾 Israel launches military incursion into Syria as UN chief demands withdrawal
item.description: Israeli forces advanced into villages in southwestern Syria, setting up checkpoints and dropping leaflets warning residents, as UN Secretary-General Guterres visited Damascus and condemned violations of Syria's sovereignty. Guterres called for all sanctions on Syria to be lifted immediately.

item.title: 🇩🇪 Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed by police during manhunt
item.description: German police shot and killed Abdul Ballout, the 21-year-old suspected of driving a van into a Berlin Pride crowd and stabbing people, killing one woman and injuring at least 29. Authorities called it a likely Islamist terror attack. Germany raised its threat level in response.

item.title: 🔥 More than 360,000 evacuated as record wildfires ravage France and Spain
item.description: Wildfires in southwestern France and Spain have forced over 360,000 people to flee their homes, with 55,000 evacuated overnight near Bordeaux alone. France has seen 42,000 hectares burned in one of its largest fires since WWII. Spain declared a national emergency as fires spread toward Madrid and Valencia.

item.title: 🇱🇧🇮🇷 Hezbollah says Iran will not sign final deal unless Israel withdraws from Lebanon
item.description: Hezbollah stated Iran has pledged not to sign a final nuclear deal with Washington unless Israel withdraws from Lebanon, as Iran's foreign minister called Israel's continued troop presence a breach of the US-Iran memorandum of understanding.

item.title: 💰🌍 The Iran war permanently altered the global economy
item.description: The global economic order has been reshaped by the US-Iran conflict, with shifts in oil markets, trade routes, and supply chains that are unlikely to simply revert to pre-war patterns even as a peace deal emerges.
